acceptance: Lowest construction-batch absolute VI residual, including unchanged parameters; no reference labels.
moment_policy: Restore original Adam moments initially; advance moments once per construction gradient even if a controlled parameter step is rejected.
scaling_policy: Equal L2 displacement to that iteration's actual hypothetical Adam update; scaled direction uses updated bias-corrected Adam second moment.
sampling: Continue parent Torch RNG; 2048 states per step, 256 zero-time physics points, remaining times uniform over full 0.5 s; identical batch prefix across arms.
evaluation: Only completed fixed endpoints; existing development states/reference at all 21 times; separate physics audit seed 991736; reserved final states remain unused.
stopping: Fixed endpoints only; fail on nonfinite loss/gradient/parameters; no development-metric early stopping.
cost_note: Controlled arm: 200 gradient batches plus 600 physics-loss trial batches. Adam 200 matches gradient batches; Adam 800 matches total physics batch assessments, not FLOPs or wall time. Report elapsed time separately.
